specification.title: Drained providers leave no eligible pivots
specification.description: No eligible pivot remains after provider work drains.
specification.purpose: Verify the investigation stops with no_eligible_pivots once provider work is exhausted and nothing actionable remains.
specification.operational_relevance: Real investigations terminate on exhaustion rather than looping forever on unreachable entities.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could loop on empty work or report the wrong terminal reason.

required: No pivot executes without eligible provider work
forbidden: The investigation continues without any eligible provider work remaining
